summary: Russia conducted widespread drone and ballistic strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions on September 5, 2026, hitting the SBU headquarters in Kyiv (5 wounded), a 9-story residential building in Boryspil, and industrial targets in Kamianske. Ukraine is reportedly planning to increase UAV deployments near Russian airports to paralyze civilian air traffic. US envoys Witkoff and Kushner's planned visit to Kyiv and Moscow is in doubt after Witkoff expressed safety concerns.
key_points: Russian drone struck SBU headquarters in Kyiv, targeting the director's office, wounding 5; Zelensky confirmed and said Ukraine is preparing a response (Source: @UkraineNow/83890).
Approximately 5 ballistic missiles hit Kamianske, Dnipropetrovsk region, striking an industrial enterprise; combined strikes reported (Source: @eRadarrua/110908).
Reactive Shahed drones tracked across multiple regions: Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Cherkasy, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Odesa, Kherson, Chernihiv, Sumy (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73758).
9-story residential building damaged in Boryspil by combat drones; no casualties reported (Source: @eRadarrua/110902).
Kherson region energy supply partially disrupted by Ukrainian strikes (Source: @tass_agency/393822).
Kyiv intends to increase UAVs near Russian airports to force suspension of takeoffs/landings, aiming to paralyze civilian air traffic in European Russia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33005).
US envoys Witkoff and Kushner's visit to Kyiv and Moscow (planned Sept 5-6) now in doubt; Witkoff reportedly 'scared' to travel (Source: @UkraineNow/83883).

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched coordinated drone and ballistic strikes across Ukraine on September 5, 2026, hitting the SBU headquarters in Kyiv (5 wounded), a residential building in Boryspil, and industrial targets in Kamianske. Ukraine is reportedly planning to increase UAV deployments near Russian airports to paralyze civilian air traffic. US envoys Witkoff and Kushner's visit to Kyiv/Moscow is in doubt after Witkoff raised safety concerns.
ukraine: SBU headquarters in Kyiv struck by Russian drone directed at the director's office; 5 wounded confirmed; Zelensky stated Ukraine is preparing a response (Source: @UkraineNow/83890).
9-story residential building damaged in Boryspil by combat drones; no casualties reported preliminarily (Source: @eRadarrua/110902).

Zelensky advisor Beskrestnov stated Ukraine needs to order hybrid inverters with batteries from China and stock fuel; noted Shahed drones are defended against but ballistic missiles carry 500kg warheads (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32996).

Kyiv plans to increase UAVs near Russian airports to force suspensions of takeoffs/landings, moving from isolated alerts to paralyzing civilian air traffic in European Russia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33005).
US House considering 'hellish sanctions' bill against Russia, may be delayed until November midterms over tariff and oil price concerns (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32989).
russia: Russia struck SBU headquarters in Kyiv with a drone aimed at the director's office; wall and ceilings destroyed (Source: @tass_agency/393812).
Russia's FSB published documents alleging German recruitment of Russian teenagers for sabotage during WWII (Source: @tass_agency/393842).
Russia urged ICAO to condemn Kyiv's interference with civil aviation; sent urgent appeal to ICAO secretary-general (Source: @tass_agency/393811).
Russia's 'Vostok' UAV operators reportedly thwarted redeployment of Ukrainian reserves in Zaporizhzhia region (Source: @tass_agency/393840).
Russia struck logistics centers, equipment, and dry cargo ships; Naryshkin accused West of 'divide and rule' logic (Source: @tass_agency/393812).
eastern_front: Kamianske, Dnipropetrovsk region hit by approximately 5 ballistic missiles in combined strikes; industrial enterprise struck (Source: @eRadarrua/110908).
Reactive drone near Piatykhatky, Dnipropetrovsk region; pair of reactive drones from Donetsk toward Dnipropetrovsk/Kharkiv border toward Poltava (Source: @eRadarrua/110879, @eRadarrua/110880).
Reactive drones from Donetsk heading to east Kharkiv region; new reactive drone from Donetsk tracked (Source: @kpszsu/76478, @eRadarrua/110885).
Reactive drone past Samara in Dnipropetrovsk heading west; another near Yuriivka (Source: @eRadarrua/110909).
Reactive drone from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava, Pavlograd district; 1 from Donetsk to Dnipropetrovsk, Pavlograd district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73758).
northern_front: Air raid alert in Kyiv from 01:58 to 00:27 and again lifted at 05:09 on September 5; new alert possible in minutes (Source: @eRadarrua/110883, @eRadarrua/110874, @eRadarrua/110894, @mon1tor_ua/73765).
Reactive Shahed from Chernihiv to Kyiv, Vyshgorod district; 2 from Kyiv to Zhytomyr, Korosten district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73758).
Reactive drone in Chernihiv region past Honcharivske heading to Kozeltsi/Kyiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/110909).
Reactive drones to Great Dymerka, Kyiv region; Geran-5 near Great Dymerka, heading toward Kyiv/Brovary (Source: @kpszsu/76471, @mon1tor_ua/73751, @mon1tor_ua/73750).

Reactive Shahed at Boryspil; 1 from Kyiv region to Cherkasy, Cherkasy district; drone cloud ~15 units in Sumy region toward Poltava, non-reactive (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73759, @mon1tor_ua/73758, @eRadarrua/110877).

Reactive drones: south of Zaporizhzhia heading to Kherson; reactive drone south of Mykolaiv region (Source: @kpszsu/76478, @kpszsu/76470).
Reactive Shahed over Odesa; 1 from Kherson to Black Sea airspace (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73758).
Reactive drone past Teplyk in Vinnytsia region heading north (Source: @kpszsu/76513).
Reactive drones south of Cherkasy heading west; 1 from Kyiv region to Cherkasy (Source: @kpszsu/76478, @mon1tor_ua/73758).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting multi-axis drone and ballistic strikes simultaneously across northern, eastern, and southern Ukraine, indicating sustained high-tempo operations. The SBU headquarters strike suggests targeted decapitation intent. Ukraine's reported plan to deploy UAVs near Russian airports signals escalation toward targeting Russian civilian infrastructure. The 500kg ballistic warhead threat noted by Zelensky's advisor indicates critical infrastructure vulnerability beyond Shahed-type defenses. The Witkoff Kushner visit uncertainty suggests diplomatic channels are strained amid ongoing military escalation.
sections.regional_response: US House considering 'hellish sanctions' bill against Russia may be delayed until November midterms, limiting near-term Western leverage. US authorities advised American pilgrims against visiting Uman for Rosh Hashanah due to security concerns, with ~40,000 expected. Zelensky's advisor called for Chinese hybrid inverters and fuel stockpiling, indicating supply chain adjustments for air defense resilience. The Kharkiv regional administration reported ~50 evacuations since year start, while alleging forced displacement by Ukrainian forces.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 'Vostok' UAV unit's reported interdiction of Ukrainian reserve redeployment in Zaporizhzhia suggests Russian ISR capabilities remain effective. Multiple Geran-5 and reactive Shahed trajectories indicate Russian drone stockpiles are being expended across broad fronts. The Azov officer's remarks about mobilizing low-income rural populations highlight potential Ukrainian manpower challenges. The language ombudsman controversy within Ukrainian security services (SBU/GUR officers speaking Russian) suggests internal cohesion issues.
